mapper.select: where enabled = '0' order by rule_type, rule_id
mapper.update: update warning_rule set enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = sysdate() where rule_id = #{ruleId}

mapper.sql: select w.warning_id, w.rule_id, w.warning_type, w.biz_sub_type, w.biz_id, w.biz_no, w.warning_content, w.elevator_id, w.receiver_id, w.receiver_role, w.is_read, w.read_time, w.warning_time, w.create_time, e.elevator_code as elevator_code, c.community_name as community_name, u.nick_name as receiver_name from warning_info w left join elevator e on w.elevator_id = e.elevator_id left join building b on e.building_id = b.building_id left join community c on b.community_id = c.community_id left join sys_user u on w.receiver_id = u.user_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from warning_info where receiver_id = #{receiverId} and is_read = '0'
select count(1) from warning_info where rule_id = #{ruleId} and biz_id = #{bizId}
mapper.insert: insert into warning_info ( rule_id, warning_type, biz_sub_type, biz_id, biz_no, warning_content, elevator_id, receiver_id, receiver_role, is_read, warning_time, create_time ) values ( #{ruleId}, #{warningType}, #{bizSubType}, #{bizId}, #{bizNo}, #{warningContent}, #{elevatorId}, #{receiverId}, #{receiverRole}, '0', sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update warning_info set is_read = '1', read_time = sysdate() where receiver_id = #{receiverId} and is_read = '0'
